items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: And what about Alex Hill? Was his band better?

ctx.x: Edmund Hall was, and then he was playing, yeah, Edmund Hall was playing saxophone with, Claude Hopkins. Then he started getting on clarinet, you know what I mean? Mm-hmm. He wasn't known as a clarinet until after later on through the years. He didn't have any kind of like clarinet. Yeah.
And what about Alex Hill? Was his band better? No, that was just a recording. He never had a band. Yeah, he was a recording. I'm trying to think of this arranger.
He was a very good arranger for that power band. The Louis Russell's band.
